_readme: Ratchet control for the specification conformance harness (layers L1/L2/L3/L5).
In enforce mode, non-waived findings whose oracle entry has confidence=high fail the relevant
test. Medium-confidence findings remain advisory. This repository currently uses enforce mode.
A waiver records a deliberate divergence. Its reason is mandatory and is included in generated
reports so readers do not need to diff this file to understand the decision.

L4_inventory is the structural layer: it measures how much of the library is measured at all (declared tokens vs the merged dictionary, themed types vs the L2 geometry matrix, template parts vs the [TemplatePart] contract, colour roles vs WCAG in every generator configuration). Its findings are advisory by construction - a finding means 'nothing asserts this', not 'this is wrong against Material' - but two of its checks are invariants and do gate an enforcing run: a template must realise the parts it names, and a declared token must resolve through the real merge.
maxChangedPixelRatio is the fraction of pixels allowed to differ by more than perChannelTolerance.
Text rasterisation differs between Linux/macOS/Windows Skia builds, so golden comparison is only
enforced on the baselineOs runner; elsewhere the diff is reported, never failed.
